{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes (especially when sentiment is negative or neutral).",
    "Adjust forecasts downward if recent sentiment shows negative bias (e.g., -0.20 or below) and historical mean reversion is observed.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction when forecast is significantly above 30-day moving average of true outcomes.",
    "Lower forecast for periods with high sentiment volatility (e.g., alternating +0.33 and -0.20) to avoid overfitting to short-term noise.",
    "Increase downward bias in forecasts when sentiment history shows persistent negative sentiment over 3-5 days.",
    "Avoid over-optimistic forecasts when true outcomes show strong downward drift from recent highs (e.g., >5% drop in 3-5 days).",
    "Apply upward correction if sentiment turns positive after a prolonged negative streak (e.g., +0.33 after -0.20 for 3+ days)."
  ]
}
